name: Sika WT-200 P
paste:
SIKA® WT-200 P: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® WT-200 P, April 2023, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sika_wt-200_p.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® WT-200 P where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. Sika® WT-200 P is a combined water resisting and crystalline waterproofing admixture used to reduce the permeability of concrete and to enhance the self-healing abilities of the concrete.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® WT-200 P has been specifically formulated to produce high quality waterproof concrete. Sika® WT- 200 P treated concrete is used as a part of the Sika® Watertight Concrete System. Sika® WT-200 P can be used in any below / in / above ground watertight structures such as:
    - Basements
    - Parking garages
    - Utility / plant rooms
    - Tunnels
    - Swimming pools
    - Water retaining structures
    - Dams
    - Waste water treatment structures
    - Underground commercial facilities (malls, transportation hubs etc.)
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® WT-200 P
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Water Resisting and Crystalline Waterproofing Concrete Admixture
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Conforms to the requirements of AS1478.1 , type Special Purpose normal setting
    - Sika® WT-200 P is approved for potable water use (AS4020-2005)
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478.1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - AS4020-2005: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - AS1012.3.1: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Concrete mix design (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika® WT-200 P consists of a mixture of cements, amino alcohols and fillers. These active materials will form non-soluble materials throughout the pore and capillary structure of the concrete and seal the concrete permanently against penetration of water and other liquids. In addition the special formula and ingredients of Sika® WT-200 P enhances the self-healing properties of concrete and will improve the ability to heal cracks in concrete. Sika® WT-200 P has the following characteristics and benefits:
    - Reduced water penetration under pressure
    - Reduced water absorption
    - Enhancement of self-healing properties of the concrete
    - Improvement in resistance against chemical attack
    - Reduced vapour transmission
    - Higher compressive strength
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Mixture of cements, amino alcohols and fillers
    - Appearance and colour: Grayish powder
    - Bulk density: ~750 kg/m³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Effect on setting: The chemical and physical composition of the components, concrete, Sika® WT-200 P and concrete and ambient temperature can affect the setting time of the concrete.
2.7 Concreting guidance. The standard rules of good concreting practice, concerning production and placing, are to be followed. Laboratory trials shall be carried out before concreting on site, especially when using a new mix design or producing new concrete components. Fresh concrete must be cured properly and curing applied as early as possible.
2.8 Concrete mix design.
    - For waterproof concrete: Concrete mix design depends on local requirements and / or local standards for watertight concrete systems.
    - For Sika® Watertight Concrete: Sika® WT-200 P has been formulated for use in concrete with a minimum binder content of 350 kg/m³ and a maximum w/b-ratio of 0.45. Depending on the specific mix design the dosage of HRW /superplasticizer has to be evaluated in order to achieve a consistency ≥110 mm (slump test AS1012.3.1)
    - Laboratory trials are always recommended to evaluate and confirm actual water reduction and consistency class.
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1.75 kg pulpable bags (6 bags/sealed plastic bucket)
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production if stored in unopened and undamaged original sealed containers.
    - Storage conditions: Storage at temperatures between 5 °C and 35 °C. Protect from direct sunlight, moisture, frost and contamination.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: 1–2 % of Sika® WT-200 P by weight of binder
4.3 Dispensing. Sika® WT-200 P is added at the time of batching to the concrete.Depending on the operation it can be dosed
    - At the dry batching plant : add Sika® WT-200 P either to the gauging / mixing water to form a very thin slurry and add it into the truck barrel or load it along with the concrete components. Then mix thoroughly for about 60 seconds/m³ . Do not add Sika® WT-200 P to wet concrete.
    - At the wet batching plant (mixer) : dispense Sika® WT-200 P and the concrete components together, mixing as per the internal production procedures.
    The w/b-ratio and consistency control remains the responsibility of the concrete producer.
4.4 Compatibility. Sika® WT-200 P may be combined with many other Sika products. Note: Always conduct trials before combining products in specific mixes and contact Sika technical service for more information and advice.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations. When using Sika® WT-200 P a suitable mix design has to be taken into account and local material sources shall be tested.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® WT-200 P, April 2023, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sika_wt-200_p.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® WT-200 P, version 31/08/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/sds-sika-wt-200-p.pdf
    - Brochure: Sika WT-200 P, version 19/05/2020, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/t/Sika%20WT-200%20P%20-%20Brochure.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: MSDS Sika® WT-200 P GHS7, https://aus.sika.com/dms/getdocument.get/324076a9-4fe1-4776-afdd-3878531fffb4/MSDS%20Sika%C2%AE%20WT-200%20P%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
